title: Train to Rock Island and the steamer St. Paul
summary: The Marable band took the train to Rock Island, boarded the St. Paul, played St. Louis, and notes the competing night bands.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: You mean the both was on?

No. We left the steam of Sydney. We left the steam of Sydney, New Orleans. So we went to go, we went to St. Louis to play on the St. Paul, Minnesota. But we didn't go to St. Louis. We went to St. Louis, and then we got the train that morning out of St. Louis. The Rock Island train. And we went to Rock Island, Illinois.
So it was you and Louis, or the entire Fayette Maril band?
The entire Fayette Maril band, all was on the train. We went to St. Louis, see. We went to St. Louis, see. Take us all day from St. Louis to the Rock Island, Illinois, on that train.
And then what did you do in Rock Island, Illinois?

Pick up the steam of St. Paul. Oh. Got on the steam of St. Paul. Then we got in there the 5th of May. Is it the Mississippi River still? Yeah. Then we went up the, we cruised up the river playing every night on the boat, further to Buick Highway, see. Then we come on back down the river, and we had to be in St. Louis for the 34th of May. The 34th of May is a big day in St. Louis, see. Then we run out of St. Louis every night on the steam of St. Paul. Now they had two bands on that boat. They had a band on the day and the night. We was a night band. Faith Mapples was a night band. What was the other band? Eddie Allen had a band at night. Was that a colored band or a white band?
